name: split
use_for: text with two to four facts or one action beside a visual
rule: swap sides once a page; change ratio between splits

name: showcase
use_for: one hero-size visual under a head block
rule: at most two smaller visuals beneath at 8/4 or 7/5

name: grid
use_for: three or four plans, products, rooms or dishes
rule: equal heights; no empty frames or icon tiles

name: bento
use_for: four to six mixed-span tiles with one clear lead
rule: two tiles at least carry a visual

name: rows
use_for: title left, line or figure right, parted by hairlines (FAQ, index, price list)

name: table
use_for: four or five rows of comparable facts

name: figures
use_for: three or four real numbers with labels

name: steps
use_for: a real process the visitor goes through
rule: real ol numerals; visual where material has one

name: statement
use_for: one sentence with attribution or action

name: band
use_for: the job's close: times, buy box, store buttons, next date
rule: never an email field by default

name: form
use_for: fields with two to four facts and one primary action

name: rail
use_for: dates, issues, products, rooms, episodes in a horizontal run
rule: five or more items; next one cut by the edge; snap points

name: pinned
use_for: one visual changing state while three or four panels scroll

name: switcher
use_for: two to five real states behind a segmented control

name: index
use_for: dense list of own items with facts in columns

name: schedule
use_for: time against place or day; opening hours strip
rule: mark current or next slot; only plan-around times

name: offer
use_for: photo or screen, options, price, action, one terms line
rule: often the hero on a buy page
